statement:
∀ (δ : ℝ),
  0 < δ →
    δ ≤ Real.pi →
      Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2 = ⋃ k, Ioo (-δ + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi)) (δ + ↑k * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
        IsOpen (Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2)
script:
# name: set-cos-preimage-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Continuous.cos_preimage
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['Real.pi / 3', '(by positivity)', '(by linarith [Real.pi_pos])'], False, "have key : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδπ : δ ≤ Real.pi), Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2 = ⋃ k : ℤ, Ioo (-δ + k * (2 * Real.pi)) (δ + k * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧ IsOpen (Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2) := by
  intro δ hδ hδπ
  refine ⟨?_, isOpen_Ioo.preimage Real.continuous_cos⟩
  ext x
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_Ioo, mem_iUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Subspace.cos_gt_iff δ x hδ hδπ).1 h1
    rw [abs_lt] at hk
    exact ⟨k, by linarith [hk.1], by linarith [hk.2]⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨(Subspace.cos_gt_iff δ x hδ hδπ).2 ⟨k, by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    linarith [Real.cos_le_one x]
exact @key (Real.pi / 3) ((by positivity)) ((by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))"),
    (['Real.pi', '(by positivity)', 'le_rfl'], True, "have key : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδπ : δ ≤ Real.pi), Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2 = ⋃ k : ℤ, Ioo (-δ + k * (2 * Real.pi)) (δ + k * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧ IsOpen (Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2) := by

  · rintro ⟨k, h1, h2⟩

    linarith [Real.cos_le_one x]
exact @key (Real.pi) ((by positivity)) (le_rfl)"),
    (['Real.pi / 2', '(by positivity)', '(by linarith [Real.pi_pos])'], False, "have key : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδπ : δ ≤ Real.pi), Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2 = ⋃ k : ℤ, Ioo (-δ + k * (2 * Real.pi)) (δ + k * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧ IsOpen (Real.cos ⁻¹' Ioo (Real.cos δ) 2) := by

    rw [abs_lt] at hk
    exact ⟨k, by linarith [hk.1], by linarith [hk.2]⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, h1, h2⟩

exact @key (Real.pi / 2) ((by positivity)) ((by linarith [Real.pi_pos]))"),
